en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 7 – Aug 13 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~422 kcal/day — down from ~644 the week before — peaking 941 on Monday's swim-plus-SUP day and 830 on Tuesday. Saturday (83 kcal) was a near-total rest day; today is still at 0, nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 675 because the day is incomplete). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −836 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Thursday (Aug 13) has not started.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Half the sessions of last week, and the mix has flipped to SUP
en.i1: 8 sessions across 5 active days, 3h 51m and ~2,951 active kcal — against 17 sessions, 4h 59m and ~3,315 kcal in the Aug 2 – Aug 8 window. Four open-water swims totalling 3,323 m and four SUP paddles totalling 7,101 m. The modality split has inverted: swim volume more than halved from 6,858 m, while SUP nearly doubled again from 3,743 m and is now the bulk of the week's distance. Two days off — Saturday (83 active kcal, the quietest day since the vacation started) and today, which has not begun. Still no gym and no logged tonnage: Hevy's last entry remains the Jul 30 squat day, so fourteen days without strength work.
en.i2t: The long continuous swim happened — twice
en.i2: Last refresh asked for one continuous 1,500–2,000 m swim instead of repeated 250s. It largely landed. Tuesday's Primošten swim ran 1,252 m in 42 minutes and Monday's 1,034 m in 35 minutes — two genuinely continuous efforts against one in the whole previous window. Average swim distance rose from 527 m to 831 m and average session length from under 18 minutes to 29. The target length was not quite hit, but the shape is right. Intensity stayed modest throughout: session averages ran 98 to 129 bpm, with Monday's 154 max the week's high, and nothing approached a hard effort. Monday was the biggest day by a distance — 4,088 m, 80 minutes, 853 kcal, effort 46 against 34 for the next-highest.
en.i3t: Sleep tracking is complete — seven consecutive nights
en.i3: Every night in the window recorded, with HRV written on each. The Mon 3 and Tue 4 gaps that sat on the chart last week have rolled off entirely, and there are no empty slots left. All Garmin streams ran clean through this morning; last night's sleep synced at 06:25. Hevy and Intervals.icu both synced before this refresh and returned no new sessions, which is an accurate empty, not a lag.
en.i4t: Recovery: deep sleep at a window high, HRV soft for a second night
en.i4: Last night ran 6h 44m — 1h 07m under the 7h 51m average — but held 98% efficiency with only 8 minutes awake and scored 81. Deep sleep was 101 minutes, 25% of the night, tying the window high and well clear of the 61 and 65 that preceded it. REM took the cut at 85 minutes, the window low. HRV is the one soft reading: 34, up a point on last night's 33 but four under the 38 average, and those two are the lowest consecutive pair on the chart. RHR did not follow — 53 this morning is the window low and it has held 53–55 all seven nights. Morning stress 19. Readiness 79, moderate.
en.rec: Nothing here argues for holding back, but nothing argues for pushing either. Load actually fell by a third this week and the swim-to-SUP shift means more time on the board and less in the water — worth noticing, because SUP at 112–129 bpm is easier aerobic work than the swims were. The continuous-swim fix worked; keep it. Two 1,000–1,300 m swims in a week beat thirteen 250s, and the next step is simply to hold that and let one of them stretch toward 1,500 m rather than adding more sessions. Two soft HRV nights (33, 34) against a clean RHR of 53 usually reads as short sleep and late bedtimes rather than accumulated load — last night was 6h 44m and two of the last three were under 7h 50m. An earlier lights-out is the highest-value change available in the next 72 hours. Fourteen days without strength is now the longest gap since February, so the first session back will feel heavy: plan it at 80–85% of the Jul 28 loads (hack squat 185 kg) and expect the bar speed, not the weight, to tell you where you are. Next: keep one continuous swim per day, get to bed before 23:00, and leave the gym alone until you are home.

hr.k3d: 4 plivanja na moru · 4 SUP · bez teretane (godišnji)
hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 7.–13.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosj. ~422 kcal/dan — naniže s ~644 prethodnog tjedna — vrhunac 941 u ponedjeljak (plivanje + SUP) i 830 u utorak. Subota (83 kcal) bila je gotovo potpuni odmor; danas je još na 0, jutros ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 675 jer dan nije završen). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −836 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Četvrtak (13.8.) još nije počeo.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Upola manje treninga nego prošli tjedan, a omjer se prebacio na SUP
hr.i1: 8 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 3h 51m i ~2.951 aktivnih kcal — naspram 17 treninga, 4h 59m i ~3.315 kcal u prozoru 2.–8.8. Četiri plivanja na moru ukupno 3.323 m i četiri veslanja na SUP-u ukupno 7.101 m. Omjer disciplina se izvrnuo: volumen plivanja više nego prepolovljen s 6.858 m, dok se SUP opet skoro udvostručio s 3.743 m i sada čini većinu tjedne udaljenosti. Dva dana odmora — subota (83 aktivne kcal, najmirniji dan otkako je počeo godišnji) i danas, koji još nije počeo. I dalje bez teretane i bez zabilježene tonaže: zadnji Hevy zapis ostaje čučanj-dan od 30.7., dakle četrnaest dana bez treninga snage.
hr.i2t: Dugo neprekidno plivanje se dogodilo — i to dvaput
hr.i2: Prošlo osvježavanje tražilo je jedno neprekidno plivanje od 1.500–2.000 m umjesto ponovljenih 250-ica. To je uglavnom ispunjeno. Utorkovo plivanje u Primoštenu bilo je 1.252 m u 42 minute, a ponedjeljkovo 1.034 m u 35 minuta — dva istinski neprekidna napora naspram jednog u cijelom prethodnom prozoru. Prosječna duljina plivanja narasla je s 527 m na 831 m, a prosječno trajanje treninga s ispod 18 minuta na 29. Ciljna duljina nije sasvim dosegnuta, ali oblik je ispravan. Intenzitet je cijelo vrijeme ostao umjeren: prosjeci treninga išli su od 98 do 129 otkucaja, uz ponedjeljkov maksimum od 154 kao vrhunac tjedna, i ništa se nije približilo teškom naporu. Ponedjeljak je bio uvjerljivo najveći dan — 4.088 m, 80 minuta, 853 kcal, ocjena napora 46 naspram 34 za sljedeći najjači.
hr.i3t: Praćenje sna je potpuno — sedam uzastopnih noći
hr.i3: Svaka noć u prozoru je zabilježena, uz upisan HRV na svakoj. Rupe pon 3. i uto 4., koje su prošli tjedan stajale na grafu, potpuno su ispale i nema više praznih mjesta. Svi Garminovi tokovi radili su čisto do jutros; sinoćnji san sinkronizirao se u 06:25. Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su prije ovog osvježavanja i nisu vratili nove treninge, što je točna praznina, a ne kašnjenje.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: duboki san na vrhuncu prozora, HRV mlak drugu noć
hr.i4: Sinoć je noć trajala 6h 44m — 1h 07m ispod prosjeka od 7h 51m — ali je zadržala 98% učinkovitosti uz samo 8 minuta budnosti i ocjenu 81. Duboki san bio je 101 minuta, 25% noći, izjednačeno s vrhuncem prozora i znatno iznad 61 i 65 koje su mu prethodile. REM je podnio rez sa 85 minuta, minimum prozora. HRV je jedino mlako očitanje: 34, bod više od sinoćnjih 33, ali četiri ispod prosjeka od 38, a to su dvije najniže uzastopne vrijednosti na grafu. RHR ga nije slijedio — 53 jutros je minimum prozora i cijelih sedam noći drži se u rasponu 53–55. Jutarnji stres 19. Spremnost 79, umjerena.
hr.rec: Ništa ovdje ne govori da treba kočiti, ali ni da treba gurati. Opterećenje je ovaj tjedan zapravo palo za trećinu, a prebacivanje s plivanja na SUP znači više vremena na dasci i manje u vodi — vrijedi to primijetiti, jer je SUP na 112–129 otkucaja lakši aerobni rad nego što su plivanja bila. Ispravak s neprekidnim plivanjem je upalio; zadrži ga. Dva plivanja od 1.000–1.300 m u tjednu bolja su od trinaest po 250 m, a sljedeći korak je samo to zadržati i pustiti da se jedno od njih rastegne prema 1.500 m, umjesto dodavanja novih treninga. Dvije mlake HRV noći (33, 34) uz čist RHR od 53 obično znače kratak san i kasno lijeganje, a ne nakupljeno opterećenje — sinoć je bilo 6h 44m, a dvije od zadnje tri noći ispod 7h 50m. Ranije gašenje svjetla najvrjednija je promjena dostupna u sljedeća 72 sata. Četrnaest dana bez snage sad je najdulja pauza od veljače, pa će prvi povratak u teretanu biti težak: planiraj ga na 80–85% opterećenja od 28.7. (hack čučanj 185 kg) i očekuj da će ti brzina šipke, a ne težina, reći gdje si. Sljedeće: zadrži jedno neprekidno plivanje dnevno, lezi prije 23:00 i pusti teretanu na miru do povratka.
